dependencies.role: Linear Dirichlet invertibility and boundary/interior elliptic regularity in the continuity method on periodic fibers.
dependencies.hypotheses: Linearized operator has zero zeroth-order coefficient, smooth data/boundary and strict real ellipticity. The prior C2 bound and det Q lower bound give uniform ellipticity and Hessian concavity on the compact convex solution range K; the cutoff leaves a neighborhood of K unchanged. Existing smooth solutions meet the regularity prerequisites of 17.14/17.26′; the primed theorem does not require (17.85). Finite local charts and uniform barriers justify the periodic-fiber reduction.
